scope: TOL-005 candidate-bound bounded/redacted Tool result retention on disposable PostgreSQL and MinIO.

observations.safe_output: A bounded redacted Artifact remains readable through the authorized public route while oversized output reaches a terminal failure without a retained Artifact/object or public raw value.
observations.limitations: This fixture proof does not exercise a protected sandbox, provider, browser, Stack, Firecracker, or Linux/KVM.

redaction: No artifact body, raw output, secret-shaped value, IDs, DSNs, credentials, or endpoints are retained.
